sources.title: CS 276 / LING 286 Information Retrieval and Web Search (Stanford, Manning & Nayak)
sources.covers: Course description and schedule: efficient text indexing, Boolean and vector-space retrieval models, evaluation and interface issues, web crawling/link-based algorithms, document clustering and classification, traditional and machine-learning-based ranking. Slides are public; the required textbook IIR chapters are free on the book site (linked from the course page).
sources.access: Free course page and slides; the 2019 edition does not have a dedicated dense-vector retrieval unit, and lecture videos were on Canvas behind Stanford credentials.

evidence.location: Course Description topic list; Required textbook paragraph
evidence.finding: The page lists 'Efficient text indexing', 'Boolean and vector-space retrieval models', 'Evaluation', web crawling/link algorithms and ranking, and says IIR chapters can be downloaded free from the book website.

sources.title: Introduction to Information Retrieval (Manning, Raghavan, Schütze) — free chapter downloads
sources.covers: The textbook behind CS276: inverted indexes (Ch1–2), tolerant retrieval, scoring/vector space (Ch6), evaluation (Ch8), relevance feedback, probabilistic IR, link analysis (Ch21). Used as the readable text when slides are too terse.
sources.access: Publisher permits free download of the chapters from the book site; the site did not respond during this check (connection timeout), so the reading link is taken from CS276's own required-textbook paragraph rather than re-opened.
sources.publisher: Cambridge University Press / Stanford NLP group

evidence.finding: CS276 states the book is required and 'You can also download and print chapters for free at the book website'; the book site itself timed out on this check.

en.section: Evaluation and interface issues；web crawling/link analysis；在线检索架构

topics.note: 中文缺检索评估指标（precision/recall、MAP、NDCG）与离线评测方法。；新增完整评价讲义给出评测集合、相关性标注、指标与算例，补全原Elastic缺的评价方法；原免费中文书仍负责查询服务、分片与近实时/零停机运维，组合覆盖整个知识项。旧书基于ES2.x，服务架构教学可读，实际部署按对应版本。

steps.read: 按「基础入门→全文搜索→分析→集群原理」顺序跟做，建立倒排索引、分析器与相关性评分的直觉。
待页面可访问后，按 BM25/稀疏+稠密混合检索教程跑一遍向量检索；当前未核到正文。
原Elastic索引和排序之后，按评价讲义构建固定查询/相关性标注集，计算P/R、AP/MAP和NDCG算例，再用相同评测集比较两个检索配置；在线服务接回原zh1分布式查询与索引切换。
读嵌入模型→写入→检索，追踪语料/查询到稠密向量和top-k的过程；生成答案可跳过。API调用需自行承担费用，本轮只登记教程。
理解HNSW逐层导航并读建索引/搜索代码；对比FLAT、IVF概念，改变ef分析召回与延迟，结合固定评测集判断取舍。
Follow the CS276 schedule: indexing and Boolean retrieval, vector-space scoring, evaluation, then web crawling/link analysis and learning-to-rank; read the matching IIR chapters.
After IIR/CS276, work through Ch1–2 (dense text vectors, exact kNN, IVF/HNSW and recall/latency experiments), then Ch6 for HNSW mechanics; keep IR relevance evaluation separate from ANN recall.
